records.jp: あー、いい景色
records.en_original: Oh, how pretty.
records.en: Oh, how pretty.

records.jp: 本当に、いい景色ね！
records.en_original: It really is!
records.en: It really is!

records.jp: ……伶那さん
records.en_original: ...Rena.
records.en: ...Rena-san.

records.jp: な、なに？
records.en_original: Wh-what?
records.en: Wh-what?

records.jp: 何でずっと上向いてるの？
records.en_original: Why do you keep looking up?
records.en: Why do you keep looking up?

records.jp: な、なななんでって景色がいいから！<CR>景色がいいからに決まってるでしょ！！
records.en_original: B-b-b-because the view is incredible! The view of course!
records.en: W-why? Because the view is beautiful!<CR>Of course it is because the view is beautiful!!

records.jp: ほんっっとにいい景色！！
records.en_original: It's the best view I've ever seen!
records.en: It's the best view I've ever seen!

records.jp: 伶那さんもしかして――
records.en_original: Rena, could it be that you're—
records.en: Rena-san, could it be that you're—

records.jp: びびってる？
records.en_original: Scared?
records.en: Scared?

records.jp: は、はぁ！？　そ、そんなわけないでしょ！？
records.en_original: A-as if! I-I'm not scared at all!
records.en: A-as if! I-I'm not scared at all!

records.jp: だってずっと上ばっかりみてるし……
records.en_original: You keep looking up...
records.en: You keep looking up...

records.jp: け、景色がいいから上を見ているだけだけど！？<CR>全然下だって見れるし！　上を見終わったら見るし！
records.en_original: I-I can see more of the view this way! I'm certainly not avoiding looking down! I just prefer it this way!
records.en: I-I am only looking up because the view is beautiful!<CR>I can look down perfectly well! I will do it after I finish looking up!

records.jp: 大体、皆の中で私が一番背が高いんだからつまりは常日<CR>頃から高い所に住んでるってわけで
records.en_original: I'm actually quite used to high places. I am taller than everyone, after all.
records.en: Besides, I am the tallest among everyone, which means<CR>I normally live in a higher place than all of you.

records.jp: 一番高所耐性が高いってことなんですけどはい論破。<CR>私は全然ビビってないし高い所も怖くないですっ！
records.en_original: That means there's no way I could possibly be afraid of heights! Understood?
records.en: Therefore, I have the greatest resistance to high places. Argument refuted.<CR>I am not frightened at all, and I am not afraid of heights!

records.jp: 伶那さん私こっちこっち
records.en_original: Rena, I'm over here.
records.en: Rena-san, I'm over here.

records.jp: 空が好きなの？
records.en_original: A big fan of the sky?
records.en: A big fan of the sky?

records.jp: ま、まあそんなところ
records.en_original: Y-yes, that's it.
records.en: Y-yes, that's it.

records.jp: じゃあ私も一緒に空を見ようかな
records.en_original: I'll try watching it too then.
records.en: I'll try watching it too then.

records.jp: だめ
records.en_original: You can't.
records.en: You can't.

records.jp: えっ……なんで？
records.en_original: Huh? How come?
records.en: Huh? How come?

records.jp: 二人ともが片方に寄ったら、<CR>気球がバランスを崩して落ちるかもしれないから
records.en_original: The balloon may go off balance if we both stand on one side.
records.en: If both of us move to one side,<CR>the balloon may lose its balance and fall.

records.jp: バランスを崩して落ちるかもしれないから！！
records.en_original: The balloon may go off balance!
records.en: The balloon may go off balance!

records.jp: わ、わかったわかった！
records.en_original: O-okay, okay!
records.en: O-okay, okay!

records.jp: （ここまで取り乱す伶那さん、初めて見たかも……）
records.en_original: (I don't think I've ever seen Rena so shaken...)
records.en: (I don't think I've ever seen Rena-san so shaken...)

records.jp: （なんだか――）
（可愛そうになってきたな）
records.en_original: (I feel kind of bad for her...)
records.en: (I feel kind of bad for her...)

records.jp: ごめんね伶那ちゃん……<CR>そうだよね、伶那ちゃんはなんでも怖いよね……
records.en_original: I'm sorry, Rena... It must be really scary for you, huh?
records.en: I am sorry, Rena-chan...<CR>That is right, everything is scary for Rena-chan...

records.jp: べ、別に何でもは怖くないからっ！<CR>っていうかちゃん付けやめて！？
records.en_original: I-I'm not afraid! That's ridiculous!
records.en: I-it is not as though everything scares me!<CR>And stop adding “-chan” to my name!

records.jp: じゃあ何が怖いんだい、お姉さんに言ってごらん。<CR>さもなくば伶那ちゃんと呼び続ける
records.en_original: It's okay, why don't you tell me all about it. I'll make you feel better.
records.en: Then tell Onee-san what frightens you.<CR>Otherwise, I will keep calling you Rena-chan.

records.jp: なんだか可愛く見えてきたな
records.en_original: You're just so cute!
records.en: You're just so cute!

records.jp: は？　何を言って――
records.en_original: Huh? What are you talking—
records.en: Huh? What are you talking—

records.jp: ほ～ら伶那ちゃん、こうやったら気球が揺れるよ～
records.en_original: Watch out, Rena! When I do this the balloon shakes!
records.en: Watch out, Rena-chan! When I do this the balloon shakes!

records.jp: あ、あぶ、な！　ほ、ほんとにッ！
records.en_original: S-stop that! I mean it!
records.en: S-stop that! I mean it!

records.jp: でも伶那ちゃんは全然怖くないもんね～？
records.en_original: I thought you weren't scared!
records.en: But you're not scared at all, are you, Rena-chan?

records.jp: お化けも暗い所も気球もおっきな虫もこわい！！！！
records.en_original: I'm scared of ghosts and the dark and hot-air balloons and bugs, okay?!
records.en: Ghosts, dark places, balloons, and big bugs all scare me!!!!

records.jp: ふふっ、素直で良きかな
records.en_original: Heheh, that's better.
records.en: Heheh, that's better.

records.jp: 下に降りたら覚えてなさいよ……
records.en_original: I'll get you once we land...
records.en: I'll get you once we land...

records.jp: でも気球が完成した時、<CR>高い所は怖くないって言ってなかったっけ？
records.en_original: Didn't you say you weren't afraid of heights when we finished the balloon?
records.en: But when the balloon was completed,<CR>did you not say you were not afraid of heights?

records.jp: こ、こんな不安定なものだとは思わなかったから……
records.en_original: I-I didn't know it would be this unstable...
records.en: I-I didn't know it would be this unstable...

records.jp: あー、なるほどね……<CR>じゃあ、そろそろ降りる？
records.en_original: Ahh, that makes sense... Shall we land soon, then?
records.en: Ahh, that makes sense...<CR>Shall we land soon, then?

records.jp: ……まだ降りない
records.en_original: I'd like to stay up a little longer.
records.en: I'd like to stay up a little longer.

records.jp: ……星崎さん、まだ乗り足りなさそうだし
records.en_original: You seem like you're not ready to go back down yet.
records.en: ...And you don't look like you've had enough yet, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 伶那さん！！
records.en_original: Rena!
records.en: Rena-san!

records.jp: あっ、ちょ！？　こっちに来ないで！！<CR>傾いてる！！　傾いてるから！！
records.en_original: H-hey! Don't come over here! It's tipping! It's tipping!
records.en: H-hey! Don't come over here!<CR>It's tipping! It's tipping!

records.jp: 伶那ちゃん！！
records.en_original: Rena!
records.en: Rena-chan!

records.jp: ちゃん付けするな！
records.en_original: Stop this!
records.en: Stop this!

records.jp: じゃあ手を繋ご！<CR>そしたらちょっとは怖くなくならない？
records.en_original: Let's hold hands then! That way it's not scary.
records.en: Then let us hold hands!<CR>Would that not make it a little less frightening?

records.jp: い、いやでも……
records.en_original: B-but...
records.en: B-but...

records.jp: 大丈夫大丈夫！　片方に寄ったぐらいで落ちないから！
records.en_original: Don't worry! We won't fall just from me getting a little closer.
records.en: Don't worry! We won't fall just from me getting a little closer.

records.jp: あっ、ちょっ！
records.en_original: Hey, wait!
records.en: Hey, wait!

records.jp: ほら、目を開けてみて
records.en_original: Open your eyes.
records.en: Open your eyes.

records.jp: どう？
records.en_original: What do you think?
records.en: What do you think?

records.jp: ……良い景色
records.en_original: It's beautiful...
records.en: It's beautiful...

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
